_about: William Ralston Shedden Ralston's (1828-1889) Russian folk tales, translated from Afanasyev's and other Russian collections, with his commentary: Russian Fairy Tales: A Choice Collection of Muscovite Folk-lore (New York, 1873), the American edition of his Russian Folk-Tales (London, 1873). Ralston is the translator, recorded in the title. Clean Gutenberg text; US public domain. Batch 21 (2026-10-03) adds Tibetan Tales, Derived from Indian Sources (1906), Ralston's English of Anton Schiefner's German translation from the Tibetan Kah-gyur; Ralston is named in the text as the translator.
